answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each identity to prove competence across unrelated domains before earning work. An agent passes graded trials in logistics, code repair, and data cleaning, and its per-domain performance vectors are hashed into a capability signature. Clones from one operator inherit nearly identical signatures, so a clustering pass flags the family and voids earnings. Attackers then face a garden of trials re-passed separately for every clone, a cost rising like a dune as identities multiply, while honest diversity flows in like a tide.
